requirements.label: 122 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The BFA in Theatre Performance: Directing requires a minimum of 122 credits. Requirements follow the 2024-2025 Silent Advisor; SMTD students follow the curriculum of their admit year.

requirements.label: Non-SMTD credits (45)
requirements.hint: At least 45 credits outside SMTD. Courses within Arts Administration also count as non-SMTD.

requirements.label: Theatre credits (67)
requirements.hint: A minimum of 67 credits in Theatre courses.

requirements.label: SMTD credits (74)
requirements.hint: The 67 Theatre credits plus a minimum of 7 SMTD elective credits. Suggested electives include THTREMUS 222, 227, 233, 325, 385, 427, MUSTHTRE 133, and MUSTHTRE 235.

requirements.label: Directing core (22 courses)
requirements.hint: Movement I, Ensemble and Imagination, Observation and Action, Research Methodology, Intro to Design, Directing I-IV, Intro to Stage Management, Intro to Technical Theatre, Run Crew, UProd Shop Practicum, Lighting I, Scene Design I, Stage Combat, Script Analysis, Theatre History I, American Theatre and Drama, Studio I, Playwriting Toward Production, and the Directing Project. A grade below C- in any Directing course does not count.

requirements.label: THTREMUS 443: Colloquium (8 terms)
requirements.hint: One credit, elected each of eight terms of the program.

requirements.label: Theatre Studies course
requirements.hint: One course chosen from THTREMUS 222 Global Performance and Ethnic Studies, 322 Theatre History II, 325 Contemporary American Drama, 326 Intercultural Drama, or 440 Topics in African American Theatre and Drama.

requirements.label: Musicology course
requirements.hint: One of MUSICOL 121 Intro to the Art of Music, 122 Intro to World Music, 123 Intro to Popular Music, 130 Opera!, or 345 or 346 History of Music. Another Musicology course may count with approval of the Head of Directing.

requirements.label: Flexible Acting/Skills elective
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule. One advanced skills course, which may include Acting VI, Voiceover, Advanced Stage Combat, Comedy, Advanced Movement, Solo Performance, or other advanced skills courses approved by the department.

requirements.label: First year writing
requirements.hint: ENGLISH 124, 125, or an equivalent first year writing course.

requirements.label: Upper level writing
requirements.hint: An upper level writing course approved by the Sweetland Writing Center.

requirements.label: Race and Ethnicity courses (2)
requirements.hint: Two courses in Race and Ethnicity selected from approved courses within LSA.

requirements.label: Shakespeare's Plays
requirements.hint: ENGLISH 367 Shakespeare's Plays or an equivalent Shakespeare course. The current catalog cycle does not carry ENGLISH 367; ENGLISH 167, 267, and 467 are accepted as equivalents here.

requirements.label: Foreign language (2 terms)
requirements.hint: Two terms of a foreign language, or proficiency.

requirements.label: Film, Television, and Media elective
requirements.hint: One FTVM course at the 200 level or above.
